title: 周末白银也能交易了：CME为何突然放开，三个周末成交2亿美元
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So what did you see a few weeks back when you launched a future school contract that made you think, okay, we're ready for silver?
segments.zh: 几周前你推出期货合约时看到了什么，让你觉得白银时机成熟了？

segments.en: Yes, I mean, we have, over the past three weekends alone, we have traded over $200 million in notion of value,
segments.zh: 是的，仅过去三个周末，我们就交易了超过2亿美元的名义价值。

segments.en: especially coming from a lot of retail interests.
segments.zh: 尤其是来自大量散户的兴趣。

segments.en: So they got us to really think, okay, the market demand is here and the client have responded.
segments.zh: 这让我们真正思考，市场需求就在这里，客户已经做出了回应。

segments.en: So for us, it's a natural step to go for the silver, given that it's a very much of a similar product.
segments.zh: 对我们来说，推出白银是自然的一步，因为它是非常相似的产品。

segments.en: How much of the demand that you're seeing out of the gate is actually sort of organic, really coming from that and how much is that kind of liquidity being provided
segments.zh: 你看到的初始需求中有多少是真正有机的，又有多少是由机制提供的流动性？

segments.en: by the mechanisms? Yeah, I mean, for us, we started with a crypto back in May.
segments.zh: 是的，对我们来说，我们从五月份开始做加密货币。

segments.en: Gold was the second that we introduced and then now with a silver, really came from the client, especially on the retail front that tends to be self-directed,
segments.zh: 黄金是我们推出的第二个，现在白银，确实来自客户，尤其是散户，他们往往自主决策、精通数字技术、钱包规模较小。

segments.en: digital savvy, smaller wallet size. They really wanted a smaller contract size to be able to trade so that when you're waking up on Saturday morning and you wanna have a directional view on that,
segments.zh: 他们真的想要更小的合约规模来交易，这样周六早上醒来时，如果你对市场有方向性看法，就能交易。

segments.en: those are the type of market participants that really demanded it and we had a lot of retail support that coming from the day one.
segments.zh: 这些类型的市场参与者确实需要它，我们从第一天起就得到了大量散户的支持。

segments.en: So you mentioned, when markets move on Saturday or Sunday, which it has been these days, we see price gap and we have to wait until Monday.
segments.zh: 你提到，当市场在周六或周日波动时，我们就会看到价格跳空，必须等到周一才能交易。

segments.en: Is that what you're trying to eliminate, the weekend gap or the pricing gap?
segments.zh: 这是否就是你们想要消除的，周末跳空或定价缺口？
